# Siavash Akbari — Creative Showcase Studio
> Portfolio, Design Research, and Thought Leadership of Siavash Akbari — multidisciplinary photographer, graphic designer, and product designer based in Esfahan, Iran. Specializing in minimal aesthetics, brand architecture, editorial photography, and tactile visual systems.

URL: https://www.siavashakbari.ir
Contact: Siavakbari@gmail.com
Location: Esfahan, Iran

## Disciplines & Core Practice
- Photography: Minimalist architectural, editorial fashion, chiaroscuro lighting, and high-contrast commercial product work.
- Graphic Design & Visual Identity: Custom logotypes, bilingual (Latin & Persian) typography, Swiss-grid publication design, and visual brand architecture.
- Product & Object Design: Heritage-inspired contemporary objects, textile deconstruction, and tactile industrial forms.

## Blog & News
The studio publishes architectural design essays and official studio announcements:

### My Blogs
- [Crafting Enduring Visual Identities in the Age of AI](https://www.siavashakbari.ir/blog/crafting-enduring-visual-identities): Why authentic visual identity requires human editorial discernment, tactile intuition, and timeless architectural grids to stand out amidst generative saturation.
  - Key takeaways: AI synthesis functions as a high-velocity sketchbook; final execution requires vector precision, optical kerning, and physical material fidelity.
- [The Geometry of Silence: Minimalist Architectural Photography](https://www.siavashakbari.ir/blog/geometry-of-silence-minimalist-photography): Exploring negative space, chiaroscuro lighting, and volumetric proportion to strip visual storytelling down to its purest emotional essence.
  - Key takeaways: Single-source hard key lighting with negative black velvet reflectors creates sculptural depth without artificial chromatic distortion.

### News
- [Studio Update: Siavash Akbari Studio Honored at Contemporary Design Awards 2026](https://www.siavashakbari.ir/blog/studio-update-2026-design-award): Recent studio recognition for Excellence in Visual Identity Architecture and Cross-Cultural Design Systems.
  - Key takeaways: Recognition for bilingual brand architecture harmonizing Latin and Persian typographic systems.
- [Exhibition Opening: Contemporary Persian Form Studies in Tehran & Esfahan](https://www.siavashakbari.ir/blog/exhibition-opening-contemporary-persian-forms): Announcing a dual-city gallery exhibition featuring our latest series of minimalist architectural prints, book covers, and object prototypes.
  - Key takeaways: Exhibitions in Tehran (October 2026) and Esfahan (November 2026) showing limited edition silver-gelatin prints and prototype objects.

## Key Projects
- Shekarchian Architectural Identity: Comprehensive identity and spatial signage for high-end Iranian architectural practice.
- Nozad Publication: Minimalist bilingual book cover designs and typography series.
- Atlasi & Sepidar Fashion Campaigns: High-contrast chiaroscuro fashion photography.
- Echo Prime & Supplements: Motion-first branding and kinetic packaging.
